benchmark: LME Copper Grade A 3-month (US$/tonne) is the profile's global benchmark; COMEX HG front month (US$/lb) is the leg the required copper.current-price row names and the leg every return figure is anchored on. The two are different instruments and are never averaged.

current_price.unavailable_reason: The required coverage row copper.current-price is status=missing: the swarm pulse quote transport is dead (PULSE-MISSING; refresh-swarm-pulse.sh fails EPERM on the pinned tsx runner's IPC pipe), so no vintaged front-month COMEX quote exists at decision time. The only price reference in this run is ~US$6.62/lb COMEX front month, 2026-08-28, an explicitly UNVINTAGED secondary web quote (TradingEconomics), not an exchange settlement; it may not be presented as a vintaged anchor.

thesis_summary: Copper rose 46.63% over twelve months and this run cannot name what caused it: three independent lenses each printed a residual near 100% (tariff premium ~0% explained; macro 0% explained with an ADVERSE sign as the 10y real yield rose 54bp to 2.36%; cost-push 10.0% explained at the maximum an assumed 1.0 pass-through could claim). Coverage is 0 of 22 required series usable, so both horizons are not_assessable and the mechanical action is Research More. IMPORTANT QUALIFIERS THAT MUST NOT BE DROPPED: the full-year 2026 balance direction is NOT ESTABLISHED (the same reported ICSG release gives +96 kt surplus and -125 kt deficit from its own growth rates, 221 kt apart with opposite signs) - the schema enum admits no 'not established' value, so the 'surplus' field carries only the REALISED year-to-date reading (Q1-2026 +396 kt, ~2.9x Q1-2025; three-exchange visible stock +30.1% YTD) and is not a full-year verdict. The 'contango' field carries the COMEX leg only, the conservative case for a long; LME cash-3M is in backwardation (+US$248/t, 2026-08-26), a ~13pp/yr carry difference on identical metal that is a venue split, not a contradiction to average. The 'crowded long' field is 98.7th percentile of 156 weekly COT reports (COMEX Copper #1, futures-only disaggregated, report 2026-08-18, ten days stale, predating the 2026-08-24 LME event in full), of which 52.8% is the ABSENCE of shorts (gross short 14.7th percentile), not long accumulation.
key_risks: The +46.63% twelve-month move is ~100% residual (unattributed) across three independent lenses - tariff premium ~0% explained, macro 0% explained with an adverse sign, cost-push 10.0% explained at an assumed 1.0 pass-through upper bound. A position whose driver cannot be named cannot be defended when it moves against it. This is the finding, not a caveat.

KILLER RISK (supply-security, carried forward whole): the pending US Section 232 determination on REFINED copper. EXPIRY: NONE - undated and open; the 2026-06-30 Commerce deadline was missed and is 59 days overdue with no replacement date. Flip triggers: bull = a Federal Register proclamation imposing >=15% effective on or before 2027-01-01 (opposing fact, not netted: one bank's model implies 14.6% odds by Jan-2027, 37% for 30% by Jan-2028 - a model output, not a market print); bear = a published determination not to impose, or 2027-01-01 passing with no duty, which would require the COMEX-LME spread to fall ~US$497/t (~91%) from US$547/t toward a ~US$50/t long-run average. It can move ~740 kt of US-located metal between accessible and trapped without changing one tonne of production - a LOCATION risk, not a quantity risk. TWO-SIDED, and the supply-security orb establishes NO PROVEN CRITICAL RISK, so nothing here may force Avoid. Magnitude unmeasured: the 2025-07-30/31 precedent is reported at 19%/20%/22% by three unverified secondary sources that disagree by 3pp on an N=1 event with no direction; today's 3.8% visible location basis explains only 17.3%-20.0% of it, 80.0%-82.7% residual.

Margin of safety is NEGATIVE on the profile's own valuation lens, on both venues: COMEX +12.3% to +21.6% premium to the incentive-price base and -39.6% to -54.7% to the floor; LME +9.6% to +18.8% and -38.1% to -53.6%. At US$6.62/lb a disclosed high-cost producer earns a 43%-47% margin over its own published AISC (First Quantum US$3.50-3.80/lb, 2026-04-28, PRIMARY). There is no cost support anywhere near this price. This may not be used to force a Trim or a short either: both anchors FAIL the section 16 stability test.

Both fair-value anchors are cycle-suspect. Every reachable incentive-price quote was struck inside the 2024-26 bull run (canonical quote 28 months stale, no published build - implied capital charge 5.9x-7.7x the undiscounted cross-check); the cost floor's own direction is contested (Codelco C1 +10.0% y/y and FQM guidance raised +9.6%, both PRIMARY, against a Wood Mackenzie relay of -13.2% whose vendor source was never reached); and most reachable cash costs are NET of by-product credits struck at record gold and molybdenum - Freeport's disclosed +-US$0.03/lb per +-US$100/oz gold means gold at US$3,000/oz raises its copper cash cost ~US$0.30/lb (~17%) with no tonne of mining changed.

The buffer is comfortable in aggregate and thin where it clears, and these are two linked readings, not one. ~968.4 kt visible three-exchange = 12.3 days of world use, +30.1% YTD, LME total at the 46th percentile of 19 years (mid-range, NOT tight, +77 kt y/y). But 69.8% sits in COMEX/US warehouses, leaving 3.7 days ex-US and an LME on-warrant slice of 1.4 days that fell 35.8% in one week, with 50.52% of LME stock already cancelled (2026-08-21). The 968.4 kt total is LME 235.6 (total, 2026-08-27) + COMEX registered+eligible 676.1 (2026-08-25) + SHFE warrant 56.7 (2026-08-19) - an approximation across 8 days and three non-fungible grade regimes. China bonded and LME off-warrant stocks are NOT MEASURED and not assumed zero, so every cover figure is a LOWER BOUND and the ex-US tightness read is the run's most fragile conclusion.

No macro cushion under a crowded long, and the crowding is half an absence. Managed money net +78,648 lots at the 98.7th percentile of 156 weekly COT reports (COMEX Copper #1, futures-only disaggregated, 2026-08-18, ten days stale) sits against a US 10y real yield at 2.36%, a multi-decade high that rose 54bp across the same window. 52.8% of the extreme is gross short at the 14.7th percentile, so little short fuel remains for further upside AND essentially nobody is structurally obliged to buy a fall. Hedgers absorbed 91.9% of the entire 53,039-lot twelve-month build. Liquidation risk is two-sided: dispersed longs (85 accounts, top-4 gross long 16.3% of OI) bleed out; the concentrated hedger short (top-4 gross short 30.3%, 79th percentile) squeezes, which is what fired 2026-08-24 and relieved 2026-08-25/26. It is not a short signal.

Venue carry, not direction, is currently the larger decision: a COMEX-rolled long needs copper to rise roughly 3% a year just to break even (roll -6.10% + collateral +3.79% = -2.31%; -3.19% to -3.37% through CPER), while an LME-rolled long is paid roughly 9%-13% (+10.69%, band +8.79% to +12.79%). ~13pp/yr on identical metal. Neither may be banked: the COMEX sign is contested by a second unvintaged source, the LME backwardation is a five-year extreme that already gave back ~half in two sessions, and there is NO physically-backed copper vehicle - every listed route pays a roll or takes equity risk, and COPX/ICOP/FCX are not expressions of a copper view.

Evidence is structurally absent, not merely thin: 0 of 22 required semantic series usable; 114 signal rows compile to 27 independent clusters with ZERO conviction-eligible and 14 flagged contradiction:true; measured primary-source production coverage 0.0% (five primary retrievals failed) giving HIGH opacity and a supply-demand directional-conviction score of 35/100; no lawful point-in-time copper price history exists anywhere in the engine (0 of 27 connectors is a price-history connector for any commodity), so N=0 non-overlapping outcomes against the section 10 floor of 30 and 0 of 3 regimes at all ten grid points.

key_levels.fair_value_range: bear US$3.00-4.00/lb (US$6,614-8,818/t; low end = 90th-pct C1 + sustaining capital, Bernstein 2025-09-04, ~12 months stale; high end = disclosed AISC for a high-cost producer, First Quantum 2026-04-28, PRIMARY) / base US$5.44-5.90/lb (US$12,000-13,000/t new-mine incentive price; anchor-grade band but an ASSERTION WITH NO PUBLISHED BUILD, canonical quote 28 months stale) / bull US$6.08-6.62/lb (ANCHOR EXHAUSTION - explicitly NOT an upside target; the highest anchor this framework can build sits at or below where the market already trades, and upside beyond the observed price is not assessable). All three are anchor-grade BANDS, never percentiles - the vendor-ranked production-weighted cost curve was not reached (three HTTP 403s). BOTH anchors FAIL the section 16 stability test: every incentive-price quote was struck inside the 2024-26 bull run, and the cost floor's own direction is contested. SUPPORT is set to 3.00 US$/lb, the floor of the bear cost band (90th-pct C1 + sustaining capital) - a medium-run marginal-supply statement, NOT a target and NOT a forecast, and if gold falls this floor RISES mechanically. RESISTANCE is null because the cost/incentive lens has NO anchor above the observed price: the COPPER profile names no demand-destruction anchor, the substitution ceiling (Cu/Al 4.2-4.3 against an indicative 3.5-4.0 trigger) appears already breached, and the reported record prints are internally inconsistent across sources, so no level above may be used as a threshold, trigger or bound.

tactical.not_assessable_reason: The empirical return envelope this horizon must be spanned against does not exist: copper.comex-price-history is structurally absent (no price-history connector exists in the 27-connector registry for any commodity), giving N = 0 non-overlapping outcomes against the section 10 floor of 30 and 0 of 3 required point-in-time regimes at every tactical grid point, so the mandatory span audit fails before any case can be sized. Independently sufficient on its own: the frozen required_series_coverage.json records 0 of 22 required semantic series usable. Horizon 64 days is catalyst-cited (ICSG biannual autumn-2026 forecast window, late September to end-October 2026), inside the 30-92 band, conservatively bracketed between the 60-day and 75-day grid points with no cross-gap interpolation - a well-formed pointer into two empty cells. The span audit FAILS on bear-to-P10, bull-to-P90, killer-risk-to-tail (twice: unmeasured in magnitude AND undated in timing), the root section 10 span check and the root section 10 conjunction check; grid mapping and no-cross-gap PASS. The duration-matched cash hurdle WAS obtained (0.665% over 64 days = US 3-month T-bill 3.79%/yr x 64/365, TradingEconomics 2026-08-26, UNVINTAGED, approximate duration match) but has nothing to classify against. Confidence in this not_assessable determination is 88/100.

strategic.not_assessable_reason: The same structural absence bites harder at this horizon: N = 0 non-overlapping outcomes against the section 10 floor of 30 and 0 of 3 required regimes at every strategic grid point, and the strategic grid additionally needs >=10 years of history for a credible three-regime split, so no matching-regime P10/P90 bound exists for a case to reach. Two further independent failures: the frozen required_series_coverage.json records 0 of 22 required semantic series usable; and NO duration-matched 12-month cash instrument quote was obtained anywhere in this run (the only rate held is a 3-month bill at 3.79%, a duration mismatch carried as a labelled proxy), so even if returns existed the classification could not be computed against a matched hurdle. Horizon 365 days is the section 11 default and no citable catalyst supports an alternate strategic date: the only dated backstop, the Section 232 recommended effective date 2027-01-01, sits at 126 days - strictly inside the 92-to-182-day gap section 11 does not cover and section 10 forbids interpolating across - and the 2028-01-01 escalation at 491 days is conditional on a duty first being imposed, which would smuggle a two-condition conjunction into the horizon definition. 365 is an exact grid point, so bracketing is not applicable; no cross-gap interpolation. Span audit FAILS on bear-to-P10, bull-to-P90, killer-risk-to-tail, the root section 10 span check, the conjunction check and the cash hurdle. Confidence in this not_assessable determination is 88/100. These figures were authored independently of the tactical horizon and share no probability, target, component or hurdle with it.

relative_view: Not assessable, and the reason is structural rather than about copper. The engine tracks twelve commodity profiles; only three others hold a decision record on disk and all three are stale against this decision date - ALUMINIUM 'Research More' 2026-07-18 (41 days), GOLD 'Hold' 2026-07-03 (56 days), WHEAT 'Research More' 2026-07-12 (47 days) - and all predate this run's coverage gate and dual-horizon contract, so ranking against them would compare two different measurement bases. The useful comparative fact: the blocker is ENGINE-WIDE, not copper-specific. The connector registry holds 27 connectors and not one is a price-history connector for ANY commodity, and no equity-history transport exists in this swarm at all, so switching to another tracked commodity would meet the same missing return history, the same absent regime labels and the same failed span audit. 'Are we in the right commodity?' cannot be answered by moving to a different one - only by fixing the shared price-history transport. One observation that survives on its own evidence, offered without a rank: copper is the only one of the four where the VENUE of the exposure is currently a larger decision than the direction of the price - roughly 13 percentage points a year of carry difference on identical metal between an LME-rolled and a COMEX-rolled long. That is a portfolio-construction fact about how copper is held, not a claim that copper is better or worse than anything else.

Without it there are N = 0 non-overlapping outcomes against the section 10 floor of 30 and 0 of 3 point-in-time regimes at all ten forecast-grid horizons, so no empirical return envelope, no drawdown, no skew, no event-gap magnitude and no matching-regime P10/P90 bound exists.
